messages:
maria_sec: :rotating_light: Found a scope leak after the RBAC refactor merged in PR #8321 — the `dev` role can read customer S3 prefixes in prod. Opening thread for triage.

auditbot: Automated alert: anomalous S3 read patterns detected for role=dev_role at 2026-03-19T21:02:14Z. See /alerts/az-8762.

tim_ops: can you paste the audit lines? need evidence before any org-wide changes.

maria_sec: grabbing a redacted sample — hitting internal logstore now. preliminary log (redacted):

```
2026-03-19T20:58:37Z | principal=arn:aws:iam::987654321:role/dev_role | action=GetObject | resource=s3://cust-data/prod/customer-123/notes.json | kms_decrypt=Succeeded | src_ip=54.234.1.18
2026-03-19T20:59:02Z | principal=arn:aws:iam::987654321:role/dev_role | action=ListObjects | resource=s3://cust-data/prod/customer-123/ | kms_decrypt=Succeeded
```

maria_sec: note: KMS CMK id=arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd was used and returned Decrypt=Allowed in the audit event.

ashwin_sre: :thinking_face: OK — suspect mapping in the new role->scope generator. quick checklist: 1) rollback PR #8321, 2) revoke long-lived sessions for `dev_role`, 3) remove temporary read scope in the lookup table, 4) run targeted audit queries to confirm no exfil.

deply-bot: deploy requested: rollback PR #8321 by @karen_engineering. CI pipeline triggered: build-4582.

karen_engineering: rolling back now and creating a hotfix branch with stricter scope intersection. patch will be small (diff below):

```
- allowed_prefixes = account_scopes[role]
+ allowed_prefixes = intersect(account_scopes[role], resource_affinity[role])
```

karen_engineering: also adding a feature-flag `rbac.strict_scoping` to gate the new behaviour until validated.

jlee_product: any sign customers were impacted or data copied externally? we need to know for comms.

maria_sec: no external egress indicators yet. only internal read API calls logged. running quick grep for `PutObject` and unusual `AssumeRole` chains. preliminary query returns 0 PutObject matching role=dev_role.

ashwin_sre: we should still rotate the CMK grant used by the dev_role if any direct key grants were made. Also revoke active STS tokens for that role: `aws sts revoke-session --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321:role/dev_role` (internal helper wraps this).

tim_ops: running the revoke now. also applying an emergency ACL: set `s3:BlockPublicAccess`-style deny for all `dev_role` reads on `cust-data` bucket via a temporary org policy.

maria_sec: updated runbook -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rbac-incident (steps 1-6). tagging @oncall to keep this live.

ashwin_sre: good call. after rollback and session revokes, run `SELECT count(*) FROM access_logs WHERE principal='dev_role' AND action IN ('GetObject','ListObjects') AND ts > '2026-03-19T20:50:00Z';` share results here.

maria_sec: query returned 42 reads in the window. most are internal debugging jobs. attaching a short redacted CSV to the ticket.

jlee_product: I'll start drafting a hold-notice in case we need to notify customers. mark as P1 for now. :exclamation:

maria_sec: root cause assigned: bug in role->scope refactor (missing intersection with resource_affinity). Action items: rollback deployed, revoke sessions, rotate key grants as precaution, add e2e test, enable feature flag, follow-up postmortem. Creating incident ticket INC-2026-0319.

ashwin_sre: once rollback confirmation in prod, we'll mark mitigation complete and start deeper forensics. thanks all.

karen_engineering: rollback succeeded at 1801203820, CI green. keeping feature-flag off until tests pass.

maria_sec: closing triage here, continuing forensic timeline in INC ticket. ping me for access to the raw logs. :white_check_mark:
